references.text: The prophecy that the dead will wake up and live, parallel to God's ability to give life to the dead.
God's promise to open graves and give life to the dead, a direct image of the life-giving power mentioned in John 5:21.
God's word giving life to dry bones illustrates the principle that the Father and the Son have the power to raise up and give life.
Jesus' own confirmation that He is the resurrection and the life, and that He gives life to whom He wills, directly linked to the Father's work.
The promise that the Father will raise up those who believe in the Son on the last day, reflecting the power to give life described in the verse.
The Holy Spirit giving life to dead bodies, as a result of God's resurrection power shared by the Father and the Son.
